notes.tone: Short, crude, direct, CABIIN-inspired party cards.
notes.ruleDuration: Temporary rules end when the next card is revealed.

cards.title: House Special
cards.text: Drink 3.

cards.title: Bar Tab
cards.text: Give 3.

cards.title: Bad Influence
cards.text: Pick someone. Both drink 2.

cards.title: Last Call
cards.text: Everyone drinks 2.

cards.title: Fuck You Specifically
cards.text: Pick someone. They drink 4.

cards.title: Cheap Date
cards.text: Cheapest drink at the table drinks 3.

cards.title: Big Money
cards.text: Priciest drink at the table gives 4.

cards.title: Group Project
cards.text: Last hand in the air drinks 3.

cards.title: U Up?
cards.text: Sent a regrettable late-night text? Drink 3.

cards.title: HR Violation
cards.text: Hooked up with a coworker? Drink 4.

cards.title: Corporate Wellness
cards.text: Faked sick to skip work? Drink 3.

cards.title: Financial Genius
cards.text: Own crypto? Drink 2. Don't? Give 2.

cards.title: Deez Nuts
cards.text: Get someone with a deez nuts joke. They drink 3.

cards.title: Smooth Brain
cards.text: Admit something dumb you believed. Drink 2.

cards.title: Would You Though?
cards.text: Most likely to text an ex drinks 3.

cards.title: Cheers, Idiots
cards.text: Cheers. Everyone drinks 2.

cards.title: Dice Tax
cards.text: Roll d6. Drink half, round up.

cards.title: Give a Shit
cards.text: Roll d6. Give that many.

cards.title: Fuckin' Math
cards.text: Roll d6. Drink 7 minus your roll.

cards.title: Pathetic
cards.text: Roll d6. 1–2: drink 4. Else give 2.

cards.title: Big Dick Energy
cards.text: Roll d6. 5–6: give 5. Else drink 2.

cards.title: Same Shit
cards.text: Roll 2d6. Doubles: give total. Else drink 3.

cards.title: That's Two Beers
cards.text: Roll 2d6. Give the total.

cards.title: Snake Eyes
cards.text: Roll 2d6. Double 1s: drink 6. Else give 3.

cards.title: Lucky Bastard
cards.text: Roll 2d6. 9+: give 5. Under 9: drink 3.

cards.title: Fuck Around & Find Out
cards.text: Roll d20. 1: drink 5. 20: give 8. Else drink 2.

cards.title: Critical Failure
cards.text: Roll d20. 1–5: drink 4. 16–20: give 4.

cards.title: God's Drunkest Soldier
cards.text: Roll d20. 20: everyone else drinks 3. 1: drink 5.

cards.title: Categories
cards.text: Pick a category. First repeat or blank drinks 3.

cards.title: Rhyme Time
cards.text: Pick a word. First bad rhyme drinks 3.

cards.title: Questions Only
cards.text: Questions only. First statement drinks 3.

cards.title: Name 3
cards.text: Group picks a topic. Name 3 or drink 3.

cards.title: Rock Paper Drink
cards.text: Challenge someone. Loser drinks 3.

cards.title: Never Have I Ever
cards.text: Say one. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Rulemaster
cards.text: Make a rule until next card. Breaker drinks 2.

cards.title: Who the Fuck Are You?
cards.text: Until next card: no names. Slip = drink 2.

cards.title: Church Mode
cards.text: Until next card: no swearing. Slip = drink 2.

cards.title: Captain Dumbass
cards.text: Until next card: call everyone “Captain.” Slip = drink 2.

cards.title: Cursed Number
cards.text: Roll d6. That number is banned. Say it = drink 2.

cards.title: Dice Lord
cards.text: Roll d6. Odd: no pointing. Even: no questions. Slip = drink 2.
